text: .2381). It is used as a colouring agent and antoxidant. Much interest has been ex- pressed in the antoxidant properties of lycopene for the potential prevention of diseases such as cardiovascular disease and some cancers, particularly of the prostate gland. Lycopene is also an ingredient of some skin preparations. ◊ References. 1. Everson KM, McQueen CE. Lycopene for prevention and treat- ment of prostate cancer. Am J Health-Syst Pharm 2004; 61: 1562–6.
